name: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia 1906 Tbk
summary: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia 1906 Tbk provides various commercial banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Indonesia. It operates through six segments: Pensioner; Employee; Commercial; Treasury; Funding; and Others. The company offers current and savings accounts; time and demand deposits; commercial, pension/retirement, employee general, mortgage, corporate, and car loans, as well as loans for micro, small, and medium enterprises; and bank guarantees.
